item.title: Awesome LLM Apps Repository Aggregates 100+ Production-Ready AI Agents in One Place
item.summary: Louis Gleeson, founder of Sentient, amplified Awesome LLM Apps on X — an open-source, Apache 2.0-licensed repository aggregating 100+ production-ready AI agents, RAG apps, and agent skills maintained by Google Cloud's Shubham Saboo and the Unwind AI team.
